scope: 36 individually inspected ordered PNG samples in fleet and coast at phone and fallback profiles.
verdict: Positive. Local hull is continuously present in the sampled 35% and 27% states and strongly reinforces the brackets during bank and impact. Revised arrows differentiate destination from subject selection.
remaining: The white flash still obscures plane detail at samples 006 and 012.
The offset blue-gray shape at the fleet bow remains ambiguous.
Fleet 060 puts Hawk briefly close to the hull tag.
No continuous timing or duration, overheating, touch ergonomics, or outpost capture claims from these frame samples.
